fields.description: Issue includes political commentary aimed at Miami voters and criticism of state-controlled gambling and the economic effects of dog tracks and horse racing. Columns and gossip items (“They Tell Me,” “I’d Like to Know,” “Notebook,” “Round the Town”) cover local personalities and social life in Miami, Miami Beach, and Coral Gables. Additional pieces discuss loan-shark practices, accusations of “blackmail” against newspapers, the Irish Sweepstakes ticket trade, and extensive racing coverage and tip sheets (including “Jockey Jimmy’s Secret Reports”), alongside numerous local advertisements.
